elements.name: furo-type-renderer
elements.description:
dynamic type rendering
---


### **Methods:**
 - **bindData(fieldNode: _FieldNode_)** - Bind a fieldnode of any type
- **focus()** - forward the focus to the created element

attributes.name: context
attributes.description:
Set the context if you need another then display.

Determines how the component should render or behave.

The variable accepts one of several predefined context types
(`"display"`, `"form"`, `"edit"`, `"cell-display"`, `"cell-edit"`),
or any other string for having custom context.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: A Boolean attribute which, if present, means this field is displayed in disabled state.

properties.name: insertedElementRef
properties.description:
Reference to the element that was inserted into the DOM.

This variable holds a reference to an HTMLElement that has been
added to the document, or `undefined` if no element has yet been inserted.
